debrief db-021
1) the actor a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d the a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t the l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and left the s-c-r-i-p-t-f-i-l-e on the d-i-s-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) the actor t-a-k-e-o-v-e-r the a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s using c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l-s and left the s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n-s in the c-a-c-h-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-w-o-f-a-c-t-o-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) the actor c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d the b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to c-a-s-h and g-o-o-d-s and left the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s in the h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n.
4) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r t-r-a-c-e-s to m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g and left the f-a-k-e o-r-d-e-r-s in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the w-o-r-k-f-l-o-w as a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r and left the r-e-c-o-r-d on file with no a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-v-i-e-w p-r-o-c-e-s-s.
